results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Extend your arms fully overhead with your palms facing each other.
Step forward with your right foot, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees. Your back knee should hover just above the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, maintaining the dumbbells overhead throughout the movement.
Alternate legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a controlled motion to prevent any wobbling or loss of balance.
Avoid leaning forward; keep your torso upright throughout the exercise.
Inhale as you step forward and lower into the lunge, and exhale as you push back to the starting position.
results.description: Dumbbell Overhead Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hamstrings.

results.name: Dumbbell Press Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands close to your chest.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and hips. Make sure your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees do not go past your toes.
At the bottom of the squat, stay in position and press the dumbbell forward in front of your chest twice by extending your arms fully, then bring it back to your chest.
Push through your heels to stand up and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes and avoid letting them cave inward.
Ensure the dumbbell moves in a straight line in front of your chest.
Use a weight that allows you to perform the exercise with proper form.
results.description: Dumbbell Press Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Triceps, Chest.

results.name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge From Step
instructions: Stand on a step with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides with your arms fully extended.
Step your right foot back off the step and lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your left knee over your left ankle and lowering your right knee towards the floor.
Just before your right knee touches the floor, push through your left heel to return to the starting position on the step, bringing your right foot forward to stand up straight.
Repeat the movement with your left leg stepping back off the step. Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain equal weight distribution between your front and back legs.
Avoid letting your back knee touch the floor.
Ensure your front knee does not go past your toes to avoid undue stress on the knee joint.
results.description: Dumbbell Rear Lunge From Step is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides with your arms fully extended.
Step your right foot back and lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your left knee over your left ankle and lowering your right knee towards the floor.
Just before your right knee touches the floor, push through your left heel to return to the starting position, bringing your right foot forward to stand up straight.
Repeat the movement with your left leg stepping back. Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain equal weight distribution between your front and back legs.
Avoid letting your back knee touch the floor.
Ensure your front knee does not go past your toes to avoid undue stress on the knee joint.
results.description: Dumbbell Rear Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge on the Spot
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing your body.
Take a step backward with your right foot, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is just above the floor.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, bringing your right foot back to meet your left.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Make sure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid putting strain on the knee joint.
Maintain a steady, controlled motion to ensure proper form and balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge on the Spot is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunges Pulses
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing your body.
Take a step backward with your right foot, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is just above the floor.
Perform two small pulses by slightly raising and lowering your body while maintaining the lunge position.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, bringing your right foot back to meet your left. Repeat the exercise for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Make sure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid putting strain on the knee joint.
Maintain a steady, controlled motion to ensure proper form and balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Reverse Lunges Pulses is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your forefeet on a weight plate with heels extended to the floor, feet hip-width apart. Place a dumbbell on each knee, holding them in place with your hands.
Lift your heels off the floor by extending your ankles, pushing through your forefeet to raise the dumbbells.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your calf muscles.
Lower your heels back just before touching the floor with control, returning to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the dumbbells stay balanced on your knees throughout the exercise.
Focus on the contraction in your calf muscles rather than using momentum.
Use a full range of motion, ensuring a deep stretch at the bottom and a strong contraction at the top.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shins.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise Hammer Grip
instructions: Sit on a bench with your right forefoot on a weightplate. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and place it on your right thigh near your knee.
Push through your right forefoot to raise your heel as high as possible, lifting the dumbbell. Briefly hold this position, squeezing your calf muscle.
Slowly lower your heel back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
tips: Fully extend and contract your calf muscle for a full range of motion.
Keep your core engaged for balance.
Avoid placing the dumbbell directly on your knee joint.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise Hammer Grip is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Alternating
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms at your sides.

Take a large step to your right with your right foot, bending your right knee and lowering your hips down and back as if you are sitting into a chair. Keeping your left leg straight and rotating it until your left foot points to the ceiling.

Lower yourself until your right thigh is parallel to the floor, ensuring your knee does not extend past your toes. The dumbbells should be hanging down towards the floor on either side of your right leg.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward excessively.
Keep your feet facing forward and your weight distributed evenly.
Make sure your knee stays aligned with your toes during the lunge to prevent strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Lunge Alternating is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Left N Right
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms at your sides.
Take a large step to your right with your right foot, bending your right knee and lowering your hips down and back as if you are sitting into a chair. Keeping your left leg straight.

Lower yourself until your right thigh is parallel to the floor, ensuring your knee does not extend past your toes. The dumbbells should be hanging down towards the floor on either side of your right leg.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward excessively.
Keep your feet facing forward and your weight distributed evenly.
Make sure your knee stays aligned with your toes during the lunge to prevent strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Lunge Left N Right is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors.
